fields.description: Primary 16-byte save magic 'KCEO PAWAPOKE1N2', written by FUN_08005e00 and verified by FUN_08005e28 against SRAM 0x0E000000.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005e00 calls func_0x08005ed0(RAM magic, 0x0e000000, 0x10); FUN_08005e28 reads 0x0e000000 via func_0x08005ef4 and compares 0x10 bytes to expected ROM magic; baseline bytes 0x00-0x0F match exactly.
fields.name: save_magic_primary

fields.description: Backup 16-byte save magic copy, restored when the primary copy mismatches.
fields.evidence: FUN_08005e00 writes the same RAM magic to the backup slot via func_0x08005ed0; FUN_08005e28 falls back to func_0x08005ef4(backup, RAM, 0x10) and re-compares 0x10 bytes; baseline bytes 0x10-0x1F match exactly.
fields.name: save_magic_backup

fields.description: 4-character alphanumeric code (password/contest entry) at the head of the 15-byte SRAM data slot; reads 'M6O5' in the live capture.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800387c writes a 0xf-byte payload from its RAM buffer via func_0x08005ed0 plus a FUN_08005f00 sum byte (dispatched by FUN_0800386c); file bytes 0x60-0x63 are ASCII 'M6O5' and sum(0x60..0x6E)&0xFF equals the stored byte at 0x6F.
fields.name: entry_code_chars

fields.description: First gameplay parameter byte of the data slot (0x12 = 18 in the live capture).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800387c payload byte 4 of the 0xf-byte SRAM slot at file offset 0x60 (RAM buffer via FUN_0800386c); sibling reader FUN_0800325c parses per-byte/bit fields of the same slot family with FUN_08005f00 sum validation.
fields.name: gameplay_param_a

fields.description: Second gameplay parameter byte of the data slot (0x38 = 56 in the live capture).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800387c payload byte 5 of the 0xf-byte SRAM slot at file offset 0x60 (RAM buffer via FUN_0800386c); validated as part of the sum8-covered range checked by FUN_08005f00 against stored byte at 0x6F.
fields.name: gameplay_param_b

fields.description: Zero-filled tail of the 15-byte data slot payload (bytes 6-14), part of the sum8-covered range.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800387c writes 0xf payload bytes via func_0x08005ed0 and FUN_08005f00 sums all 0xf bytes into the stored byte at 0x6F; baseline bytes 0x66-0x6E are zero and included in the verified sum.
fields.name: slot_data_tail
